trend_note: Japanese curry and modern Thai concepts dominating Bangkok's new openings this month

entries.name: Curry Up Bangkok
entries.description: First Southeast Asia outpost of NIGO's Japanese curry concept from Human Made — butter chicken curry and eggplant curry starting at 245 baht, inside Central Embassy next to Human Made store

entries.name: Somsak
entries.description: Modern Isan from the team behind Fatboy Izakaya and Kim Jeong Grill — som tam, laab, grilled meats and sharing plates at Ekkamai Corner, punchy flavours done with personality

entries.name: Wisetwiso
entries.description: Fine-dining rooted in royal Thai culinary traditions, reinterpreted through a contemporary lens by Chef Chakkrapoom Boonyakom — inside a restored house on Chuea Phloeng Road

entries.name: Jakawaan
entries.description: Tapas-style Thai bites and structured samrub dining off Thonglor Soi 9, led by food stylist and designer Chef Nick — Thai dining reinvented as a sharing experience

entries.name: Quilombo
entries.description: Argentine steakhouse inside a stone-clad castle on Thonglor Soi 5 — concise menu of Argentine ranching traditions, fire and meat, designed by Christopher Mark and Manuel Palacio

entries.name: Iris & Wild Iris
entries.description: Dual-concept rooftop on the 29th floor of SO/ Bangkok — Iris restaurant with panoramic Lumphini Park views and French-Italian-Spanish menu, Wild Iris for cocktails and sunsets

entries.name: Sato San
entries.description: Thai-Isaan meets Japanese precision on the 32nd floor of Moxy Bangkok Ratchaprasong — rooftop with DJ sets Wed-Sat and skyline views, open daily from 6PM
